allowlist.reason: Each workspace's jsdom setup stands alone: the design system's tests may not import the app (MAR-3610), so the shims its primitives need (ResizeObserver, scrollIntoView, the Event constructors) are written out again there. Test support, not product code.

The two dialogs' filter Selects are the same on purpose: one way to label a filter, a caption in its Field (DLG-21). Two copies are allowed; the third use makes it a FilterSelect in @convergence/ui (the audit's ruling), not a third copy.
